title: SPEKTRAN: AI Agent-ready simulation engine and ML benchmark for optical gas sensing
description: AI Agent-ready simulation engine and ML benchmark for optical gas sensing. 5 modalities (TDLAS, NDIR, CRDS, FTIR, DOAS). Full ML pipeline operable via natural language and structured CLI. v0.6.0: 10 target molecules, 9 benchmark tasks (T1-T9), 25 ML baselines, 46 virtual instruments, JSON-output CLI for AI agent integration. Built on hapi (HITRAN API) for spectroscopic physics.
notes: Code is Apache-2.0; generated datasets and the data schema are CC BY 4.0. Dataset archives deposited separately with their own DOI at each major release.
